_editing: Add new releases to the front of the 'releases' array. The first release is featured on the home page. Add cover art to /public/releases and set 'cover' to its path (e.g. "/releases/another-time.jpg") — when 'cover' is empty the site renders a styled vinyl disc instead. 'year' and per-track 'duration'/'links' are optional and only render when set. 'totalTracks' lets the site show the album size even while the tracklist below is still being filled in. 'spotifyEmbedId' is the Spotify album/track ID for the embed player. Only add links that actually exist — every entry renders as a live link.
